code:
NIST SP 800-207 does NOT say:
  "deploy a ZTNA gateway"
  "buy a CASB"

It says what the architecture must satisfy —
built from controls you already own:
  Conditional Access   -> dynamic policy (tenet 4)
  Intune / SSM posture  -> continuous monitoring (tenet 5)
  OAuth/OIDC tokens      -> per-session access (tenet 3)
  SIEM / XDR pipelines   -> feedback loop (tenet 7)
caption: Zero Trust is an architectural target, assembled from pieces you already run.
